readme: Advisories npm audit may report that CI accepts, each with why and until when (scripts/audit-check.mjs). Only an advisory with no patched release, in development tools only, may be listed; runtime dependencies must audit clean (npm audit --omit=dev), and an entry past its expiry fails CI. Approved by the owner on 17 Nov 2026.

allow.reason: ReDoS through repeated extglobs, published 17 Nov 2026 with every version affected and no patched release. Reached only through test and lint tooling (vitest, vite, typescript-eslint); no runtime dependency uses it (npm audit --omit=dev: 0).
